  36 | ## Chart Templates
  37 | ### Word Count
  38 | Use command `Insert Template` -> `Word Count` to insert code block.
  39 | ```chartsview
  40 | #-----------------#
  41 | #- chart type    -#
  42 | #-----------------#
  43 | type: WordCloud
  44 | 
  45 | #-----------------#
  46 | #- chart data    -#
  47 | #-----------------#
  48 | data: "wordcount:Words"
  49 | 
  50 | #-----------------#
  51 | #- chart options -#
  52 | #-----------------#
  53 | options:
  54 |   wordField: "word"
  55 |   weightField: "count"
  56 |   colorField: "count"
  57 |   wordStyle:
  58 |     rotation: 30
  59 | ```
  60 | ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/150803/136478725-be28a56b-0075-4f0a-a719-f61b30e83b6a.png)
  61 | 
  62 | #### Multi files
  63 | ```
  64 | data: "wordcount:Words,PARA,@Inbox/"
  65 | ```
  66 | 
  67 | #### ALL files
  68 | ```
  69 | data: "wordcount:/"
  70 | ```
  71 | 
  72 | #### Folder
  73 | ```
  74 | data: "wordcount:@Inbox/"
  75 | ```

 144 | ## Data from CSV file
 145 | 
 146 | ### Import data from external CSV file (Desktop)
 147 | Use command `Charts View: Import data from external CSV file` to insert data from CSV file.
 148 | 
 149 | ### Load data from internal CSV file
 150 | Load CSV file from data path.
 151 | Data path should be specified in settings.
 152 | 
 153 | ```chartsview
 154 | #-----------------#
 155 | #- chart type    -#
 156 | #-----------------#
 157 | type: Mix
 158 | 
 159 | #-----------------#
 160 | #- chart data    -#
 161 | #-----------------#
 162 | data.area:
 163 |   - time: 1246406400000
 164 |     temperature: [14.3, 27.7]
 165 |   - time: 1246492800000
 166 |     temperature: [14.5, 27.8]
 167 |   - time: 1246579200000
 168 |     temperature: [15.5, 29.6]
 169 |   - time: 1246665600000
 170 |     temperature: [16.7, 30.7]
 171 |   - time: 1246752000000
 172 |     temperature: [16.5, 25.0]
 173 |   - time: 1246838400000
 174 |     temperature: [17.8, 25.7]
 175 | 
 176 | data.line: LineData.csv
 177 | 
 178 | #-----------------#
 179 | #- chart options -#
 180 | #-----------------#
 181 | options:
 182 |   appendPadding: 8
 183 |   syncViewPadding: true
 184 |   tooltip:
 185 |     shared: true
 186 |     showMarkers: false
 187 |     showCrosshairs: true
 188 |     offsetY: -50
 189 | 
 190 | options.area:
 191 |   axes: {}
 192 |   meta:
 193 |     time:
 194 |       type: 'time'
 195 |       mask: 'MM-DD'
 196 |       nice: true
 197 |       tickInterval: 172800000
 198 |       range: [0, 1]
 199 |     temperature:
 200 |       nice: true
 201 |       sync: true
 202 |       alias: '温度范围'
 203 |   geometries:
 204 |     - type: 'area'
 205 |       xField: 'time'
 206 |       yField: 'temperature'
 207 |       mapping: {}
 208 | 
 209 | options.line:
 210 |   axes: false
 211 |   meta:
 212 |     time:
 213 |       type: 'time'
 214 |       mask: 'MM-DD'
 215 |       nice: true
 216 |       tickInterval: 172800000
 217 |       range: [0, 1]
 218 |     temperature:
 219 |       sync: 'temperature'
 220 |       alias: '温度'
 221 |   geometries:
 222 |     - type: 'line'
 223 |       xField: 'time'
 224 |       yField: 'temperature'
 225 |       mapping: {}
 226 |     - type: 'point'
 227 |       xField: 'time'

 254 |   yAxis:
 255 |     value:

 261 |           }

 264 |     - geometry: 'line'

 269 | 
 270 | ## Dataview Plugin Integration
 271 | 
 272 | ### Allowed methods
 273 | * dv.current()
 274 | * dv.pages(source?)
 275 | * dv.pagePaths(source?)
 276 | * dv.page(path)
 277 | * dv.array(value)
 278 | * dv.isArray(value)
 279 | * dv.date(text)
 280 | * dv.fileLink(path, embed?, display-name?)
 281 | * dv.date(pathlike)
 282 | * dv.query(source, settings?)
 283 | * dv.io
 284 | 
 285 | See [Dataview Codeblock Reference](https://blacksmithgu.github.io/obsidian-dataview/api/code-reference/)
 286 | 
 287 | ## Interaction
 288 | ### Enable search interaction
 289 | Enable the Search in Obsidian interaction when click a chart element by add an option `enableSearchInteraction`.
 290 | Use default: 
 291 | ```
 292 | #-----------------#
 293 | #- chart options -#
 294 | #-----------------#
 295 | options:
 296 |   ...
 297 |   enableSearchInteraction: true
 298 | ```
 299 | or custom:
 300 | ```
 301 | #-----------------#
 302 | #- chart options -#
 303 | #-----------------#
 304 | options:
 305 |   ...
 306 |   enableSearchInteraction:
 307 |     field: 'word'
 308 |     operator: 'path'
 309 | ```
 310 | - `field` indicate where to get keyword for search.
 311 | - `operator` enums from [Obsidian search opertaors](https://help.obsidian.md/Plugins/Search#Search+operators):
 312 | 
 313 | | operator     | Obsidian search opertaor |
 314 | | ------------ | ------------------------ |
 315 | | `default`    |                          |
 316 | | `tag`        | `tag:`                   |
 317 | | `path`       | `path:`                  |
 318 | | `file`       | `file:`                  |
 319 | | `task`       | `task:`                  |
 320 | | `taskTodo`   | `task-todo:`             |
 321 | | `taskDone`   | `task-done:`             |
 322 | | `matchCase`  | `match-case:`            |
 323 | | `ignoreCase` | `ignore-case:`           |
 324 | | `line`       | `line:`                  |
 325 | | `block`      | `block:`                 |
 326 | | `content`    | `content:`               |
 327 | | `section`    | `section:`               |
 328 | | `fileopen`   | Open a file inside Vault |
 329 | 
 330 | ## Examples
 331 | 
 332 | See https://github.com/caronchen/obsidian-chartsview-plugin/wiki/Chart-examples
 333 | 
 334 | ## Manually installing the plugin
 335 | 
 336 | - Copy over `main.js`, `styles.css`, `manifest.json` to your vault `VaultFolder/.obsidian/plugins/obsidian-chartsview-plugin/`.
 337 | 
 338 | ## Ant Design Charts Demos
 339 | 
 340 | See https://charts.ant.design/en/examples/gallery
 341 | 
```

  13 | const WITHOUT_WRAPPER = (searchWord: string) => encodeURIComponent(searchWord);
  14 | const PARENTHESIS_WRAPPER = (searchWord: string) => `(${encodeURIComponent(searchWord)})`;
  15 | const QUOTE_WRAPPER = (searchWord: string) => `"${encodeURIComponent(searchWord)}"`;
  16 | const PARENTHESIS_QUOTE_WRAPPER = (searchWord: string) => `("${encodeURIComponent(searchWord)}")`;
  17 | 
  18 | /**
  19 |  * 鼠标形状的 Action
  20 |  */
  21 | class ObsidianAction extends Action {
  22 | 
  23 |   private search(arg: Record<string, string>, prefix: string, replacer?: (searchWord: string) => string) {
  24 |     const data = this.context.event.data;
  25 |     const { shape, data: field } = data;
  26 |     let searchWord: string = undefined;
  27 |     if (shape === 'word-cloud') {
  28 |       searchWord = field.text;
  29 |     } else {
  30 |       searchWord = arg ? field[arg.field] : "";
  31 |     }
  32 |     if (replacer) {
  33 |       searchWord = replacer(searchWord);
  34 |     }
  35 |     this.openScheme(`obsidian://search?vault=${encodeURIComponent(arg.vault)}&query=${prefix}${searchWord}`);
  36 |   }
  37 | 
  38 |   private openNote(arg: Record<string, string>) {
  39 |     const data = this.context.event.data;
  40 |     const { shape, data: field } = data;
  41 |     let path: string = undefined;
  42 |     if (shape === 'word-cloud') {
  43 |       path = field.datum[arg.pathField];
  44 |     } else {
  45 |       path = field[arg.pathField];
  46 |     }
  47 |     this.openScheme(`obsidian://vault/${encodeURIComponent(arg.vault)}/${path}`);
  48 |   }
  49 | 
  50 |   private openScheme(url: string) {
  51 |     const tmpLink = window.document.body.createEl('a', {href: url});
  52 |     tmpLink.click();
  53 |     tmpLink.remove();
  54 |   }
  55 |

  58 |   }

  36 |     const config = (type === "MultiView" || type === "Mix") ?
  37 |         await parseMultiViewConfig(dataProps, data, options, plugin, sourcePath)
  38 |         :
  39 |         { data: await loadFromFile(data, plugin, sourcePath, options), ...customOptions(options, plugin) };
  40 | 
  41 |     //@ts-ignore
  42 |     const useDefaultBgColor = config.theme?.background === undefined && config.theme?.styleSheet?.backgroundColor === undefined;
  43 | 
  44 |     config.theme = config.theme ?? getTheme(plugin.settings.theme);
  45 | 
  46 |     if (useDefaultBgColor) {
  47 |         //@ts-ignore
  48 |         config.theme.background = plugin.settings.backgroundColor;
  49 |     }
  50 | 
  51 |     config.appendPadding = config.appendPadding ?? [
  52 |         plugin.settings.paddingTop, plugin.settings.paddingRight,
  53 |         plugin.settings.paddingBottom, plugin.settings.paddingLeft
  54 |     ];
  55 | 
  56 |     return {
  57 |         type,
  58 |         showExportBtn: plugin.settings.showExportBtn,
  59 |         config
  60 |     };
  61 | }
  62 | 
  63 | function stringToFunction(options: Options): Options {
  64 |     for (const key in options) {
  65 |         const value = options[key];
  66 |         if (value) {
  67 |             if (typeof value === "string" && functionRegex.test(value)) {
  68 |                 options[key] = (0, eval)(`(${value})`);
  69 |             } else if (Array.isArray(value)) {
  70 |                 options[key] = value.map(stringToFunction);
  71 |             } else if (typeof value === "object") {
  72 |                 options[key] = stringToFunction(value as Options);
  73 |             }
  74 |         }
  75 |     }
  76 |     return options;
  77 | }
  78 | 
  79 | function customOptions(options: Options, plugin: ChartsViewPlugin): Options {
  80 |     const { enableSearchInteraction, interactions } = options;
  81 |     if (enableSearchInteraction !== true && typeof enableSearchInteraction !== "object") {
  82 |         return options;
  83 |     }
  84 | 
  85 |     const customedInteractions = interactions ?? [];
  86 |     if (!Array.isArray(customedInteractions)) {
  87 |         return options;
  88 |     }
  89 | 
  90 |     const interaction = {
  91 |         type: "obsidian-search",
  92 |         cfg: {
  93 |             start: [{
  94 |                 trigger: "element:click",
  95 |                 action: "obsidian-search:default",
  96 |                 arg: {
  97 |                     field: 'text',
  98 |                     pathField: 'path',
  99 |                     vault: plugin.app.vault.getName()
 100 |                 }
 101 |             }]
 102 |         }
 103 |     }
 104 |     if (typeof enableSearchInteraction === "object") {
 105 |         //@ts-ignore
 106 |         interaction.cfg.start[0].action = `obsidian-search:${enableSearchInteraction.operator ?? "default"}`;
 107 |         //@ts-ignore
 108 |         interaction.cfg.start[0].arg.field = enableSearchInteraction.field ?? "text";
 109 |         //@ts-ignore
 110 |         interaction.cfg.start[0].arg.pathField = enableSearchInteraction.pathField ?? "path";
 111 |     }
 112 |     customedInteractions.push(interaction);
 113 | 
 114 |     delete options.enableSearchInteraction;
 115 | 
 116 |     options.interactions = customedInteractions;
 117 |     return options;
 118 | }
 119 | 
 120 | async function parseMultiViewConfig(dataProps: DataProps, data: DataType, options: Options, plugin: ChartsViewPlugin, sourcePath: string): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
 121 |     const temp = new Map<string, Record<string, unknown>>();
 122 |     const views: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
 123 | 
 124 |     for (const key in dataProps) {
 125 |         const keyParts = key.split(".");
 126 |         if (keyParts.length !== 2
 127 |             || (keyParts[0] !== "options" && keyParts[0] !== "data")) {
 128 |             continue;
 129 |         }
 130 | 
 131 |         const viewType = keyParts[1];
 132 |         const view = temp.get(viewType) || {};
 133 |         view[keyParts[0]] = dataProps[key];
 134 |         temp.set(viewType, view);
 135 |     }
 136 | 
 137 |     for (const v of temp.values()) {
 138 |         views.push({ data: await loadFromFile(v["data"], plugin, sourcePath, options) || data, ...customOptions(stringToFunction(v["options"] as Options || {}), plugin) });
 139 |     }
 140 | 
 141 |     return { views, ...options };
 142 | }
 143 | 
 144 | async function loadFromFile(data: DataOptionType, plugin: ChartsViewPlugin, sourcePath: string, options: Options): Promise<DataType> {
 145 |     if (typeof data === "string") {
 146 |         if (data.startsWith("wordcount:")) {
 147 |             const file = data.replace("wordcount:", "");
 148 |             return loadFromMdWordCount(file.length > 0 ? file : (plugin.app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(sourcePath) as TFile).basename, plugin, options);
 149 |         } else if (data.startsWith("dataviewjs:")) {
 150 |             return loadFromDataViewPlugin(data.replace("dataviewjs:", ""), plugin, sourcePath);
 151 |         } else {
 152 |             return loadFromCsv(data, plugin);
 153 |         }
 154 |     } else {
 155 |         return data;
 156 |     }
 157 | }
 158 | 
 159 | const dataViewApiProxy = function (api: DataviewApi, currentFilePath: string) {
 160 |     return {
 161 |         pagePaths: function (query?: string): DataArray<string> {
 162 |             return api.pagePaths(query, currentFilePath);
 163 |         },
 164 |         page: function (path: string | Link): Record<string, Literal> | undefined {
 165 |             return api.page(path, currentFilePath);
 166 |         },
 167 |         pages: function (query?: string): DataArray<Record<string, Literal>> {
 168 |             return api.pages(query, currentFilePath);
 169 |         },
 170 |         current: function (): Record<string, Literal> | undefined {
 171 |             return api.page(currentFilePath, currentFilePath);
 172 |         },
 173 |         array: function (raw: unknown): DataArray<any> {
 174 |             return api.array(raw);
 175 |         },
 176 |         isArray: function (raw: unknown): raw is DataArray<any> | Array<any> {
 177 |             return api.isArray(raw);
 178 |         },
 179 |         fileLink: function (path: string, embed?: boolean, display?: string): Link {
 180 |             return api.fileLink(path, embed, display);
 181 |         },
 182 |         date: function (pathlike: string | Link | DateTime): DateTime | null {
 183 |             return api.date(pathlike);
 184 |         },
 185 |         query(source: string | Query, settings?: QueryApiSettings): Promise<Result<QueryResult, string>> {
 186 |             return api.query(source, currentFilePath, settings);
 187 |         },
 188 |         io: api.io
 189 |     }
 190 | };
 191 | 
 192 | async function loadFromDataViewPlugin(content: string, plugin: ChartsViewPlugin, sourcePath: string): Promise<DataType> {
 193 |     if (plugin.app.plugins.enabledPlugins.has("dataview")) {
 194 |         const api: DataviewApi = plugin.app.plugins.plugins.dataview?.api;
 195 |         if (api) {
 196 |             const invoke = new AsyncFunction("dv", content);
 197 |             const dv = dataViewApiProxy(api, sourcePath);
 198 |             return await invoke(dv);
 199 |         } else {
 200 |             throw new Error(`Obsidian Dataview is not ready.`);
 201 |         }
 202 |     } else {
 203 |         throw new Error(`Obsidian Dataview is required.`);
 204 |     }
 205 | }
 206 | 
 207 | async function loadFromMdWordCount(fileName: string, plugin: ChartsViewPlugin, options: Options): Promise<DataType> {
 208 |     const fileOrPaths = fileName.split(",");
 209 |     const contents: Array<string> = [];
 210 |     for (const file of plugin.app.vault.getMarkdownFiles()) {
 211 |         if (file.basename == fileName || fileOrPaths.contains(file.basename) || containedParent(file.parent, fileOrPaths)) {
 212 |             const content = await plugin.app.vault.cachedRead(file);
 213 |             contents.push(content);
 214 |         }
 215 |     }
 216 |     if (contents.length == 0) {
 217 |         throw new Error("No words found.");
 218 |     }
 219 |     const wordCount = getWordCount(contents.join("\n"), plugin.settings.wordCountFilter);
 220 |     const { minWordCount } = options;
 221 |     if (typeof minWordCount === 'number') {
 222 |         delete options.minWordCount;
 223 |         return wordCount.filter(item => item.count >= minWordCount);
 224 |     }
 225 |     return wordCount;
 226 | }
 227 | 
 228 | function containedParent(folder: TFolder, fileOrPaths: Array<string>): boolean {
 229 |     const contained = fileOrPaths.contains(`${folder.name}/`);
 230 |     if (contained || folder.parent == undefined) {
 231 |         return contained;
 232 |     } else {
 233 |         return containedParent(folder.parent, fileOrPaths);
 234 |     }
 235 | }
 236 | 
 237 | async function loadFromCsv(data: string, plugin: ChartsViewPlugin): Promise<DataType> {
 238 |     const csvFileNames = data.split(",");
 239 |     const value = [];
 240 |     for (const name of csvFileNames.values()) {
 241 |         const path = plugin.settings.dataPath === '/' ? '' : `${plugin.settings.dataPath}/`;
 242 |         const file = plugin.app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(`${path}${name.trim()}`);
 243 |         if (file instanceof TFile) {
 244 |             value.push(parseCsv(await plugin.app.vault.read(file)));
 245 |         } else {
 246 |             value.push({});
 247 |         }
 248 |     }
 249 |     if (value.length == 0) {
 250 |         return {};
 251 |     }
 252 |     if (value.length == 1) {
 253 |         return value[0];
 254 |     }
 255 |     return value;
 256 | }

  74 |             words[match] = words[match] ? words[match] + 1 : 1;
  75 |         });
  76 |     }

  83 |     }
